# Alternatives to the Claude app

Updated November 25, 2026 · prices from the US App Store

Anthropic's Claude app is the most direct way to use Claude, and Claude Pro is $20 a month. Some people want Claude next to other models, a lower price, or Claude without an account. These are the options.

## The options

1. **[Omnimo](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6504996891)** (made by the team behind this site): Claude next to other makers' models. Claude Haiku 5.5 is free (a few messages a day); Claude Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 are in Omnimo Pro, next to GPT-6, Gemini and Grok. No account. *Price (US): free to start; $6.99 a week (3-day free trial), $9.99 a month or $39.99 a year (1-week free trial). US prices; the app shows the price for your country.* See [Claude in Omnimo](https://www.privateslm.dev/models/claude-sonnet.html).

2. **[Poe](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1640745955)** (Quora): best for Claude among many bots. Poe offers Anthropic's models among many others. *Price (US): Basic $4.99 a month or $49.99 a year, Plus $19.99 a month or $199.99 a year (in-app purchase list); usage is counted in points.*

3. **[ChatGPT](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6448311069)** (OpenAI): best for OpenAI's models. The most used assistant, with voice and memory. *Price (US): ChatGPT Go $8.00, ChatGPT Plus $19.99, ChatGPT Pro from $100 (in-app purchase list); Plus is $20 a month on OpenAI's site (3 November 2026).*

4. **[Google Gemini](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6477489729)** (Google): best for Google's apps. Gemini with Gmail, Calendar and Photos. *Price (US): Google AI Plus $4.99, Google AI Pro $19.99, Google AI Ultra $199.99 (in-app purchase list; the plans include Google storage).*

5. **[Perplexity](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1668000334)** (Perplexity AI): best for research with sources. Citations on every answer. *Price (US): Perplexity Pro $20.00 (also listed at $200.00), Perplexity Max $200.00, credit packs from $5.00 (in-app purchase list).*

Ratings, prices and features: each app's US App Store listing and list of in-app purchases, read 25 November 2026. The App Store lists in-app purchases without their billing period; where a listing doesn't say, neither do we.

## How we chose

We list apps we have looked at closely, with what their own listings say. We make Omnimo, so it is on every list; we have tried to say plainly when another app is the better choice.

## Questions

### Can I use Claude without the Claude app?

Yes. Apps such as Omnimo and Poe offer Anthropic's Claude models; Omnimo uses Anthropic's API. Features of Anthropic's own app, such as projects and connectors, are only in the Claude app.

### Is Claude free in Omnimo?

Claude Haiku 5.5 is one of Omnimo's free cloud models, with a few messages a day. Sonnet, Opus and Fable are part of Omnimo Pro.

[Get Omnimo — free](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6504996891)
